speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling in your palms; to start our workup, have you noticed any blisters, scaling, or discoloration on your hands or feet? Also, do you experience joint pain, hair loss, or Raynaud's phenomenon (fingers changing color in cold)?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Not yet ready. While your symptoms of pruritus, numbness, and tingling with a history of farming could suggest scabies or porphyria cutanea tarda, I need more specific details. Have you noticed skin fragility, blistering on sun-exposed areas, or abdominal pain? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_and_Bilirubin. REQUEST TEST: Urobilinogen_and_Porphobilinogen. REQUEST IMAGES: Skin_biopsy_of_lesion.
